newsitem.title: USA: Ecopetrol to sell Vasconia crude for October.
newsitem.headline: Ecopetrol to sell Vasconia crude for October.

text.p: Colombia's state oil company Ecopetrol was seeking bids for Vasconia crude oil to load in late October, trade sources said Monday.
The 500,000-barrel Vasconia cargo was scheduled to load October 26-30, and the tender closes on Wednesday.
Traders assessed Vasconia, a heavy crude, around West Texas Intermediate minus $2.00 FOB.
A report Ecopetrol was negotiating a three-month Cano Limon term contract, starting in October, was dismissed.
"There was no official tender. These were probably inquiries about extra end-year supplies," a trader said.
Elsewhere, Uruguay's state oil refiner ANCAP purchased some one million barrels of Nigerian Forcados from a European trader for November 5-10 last week.
The cargo was estimated done at a lower price than Dated Brent plus 40 cts FOB, traders said.
